arg.name: testbench
arg.description: a testbench by name, built in the sourced workspace (its stack runs in the host's work directory for it); empty: project:

arg.name: project
arg.description: the project: a directory or pkg://<package>; empty: the working directory's

arg.name: seat
arg.description: a seat number or auto; empty: the host settings' seat:

arg.name: simulator
arg.description: carla or isaac; empty: the project's simulator:

arg.name: simulator_start
arg.description: auto, start or external: whether the stack starts CARLA itself; empty: the host settings' carla.start (auto)

arg.name: map
arg.description: the map the stack's pilots start on; empty: the first run's (CARLA), the first the project's scenarios name (Isaac)

arg.name: logs
arg.description: the log root; empty: the host settings' logs:

arg.name: gpu
arg.description: the GPU index; empty: the seat's

arg.name: launcher
arg.description: auto, play_launch or ros2: the launcher of the stack's nested launches; empty: the host settings' launcher: (auto)

arg.name: stack_args
arg.description: name:=value ... for stack.launch.py, after scensim's own (they win); side_args and sim_args merge by name with scensim's, whose own names are refused
